epic.title: Epic 569: attestation that can fail — evidence, review, instruments
epic.intent_and_why: Make a green qualitative gate mean something by telling the agent what would count at plan time, not by telling it at attest time that it got it wrong. 65 of 105 conditions in the shipped spine templates are check:null.

definition_of_done: A qualitative condition declares, at plan time, what evidence would satisfy it.
A wedged verdict is impossible to express silently.
The journal distinguishes a repaired fail from a gate that never failed.
Every check this epic ships is reachable from a template command check, or allowlisted with a stated reason.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: This epic must not add machinery that is itself unwired.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Measured census plus red-proof pinned to the shipped revision; a report-only check must name its promotion trigger.
good_enough.appetite: Four waves; cleared autonomous through wave 2, stop-and-present before wave 3.

hard_constraints: Report-only is a staging state for an unmeasured signal, never a substitute for adjudication.
Sonnet for every commander and crew slot; escalate to opus only on a double block.
Fix or write an episode; filing an issue is the disfavoured exit.
Do not engage the spec-to-template migration (human ruling; episodes/active/569-001.md).
fixed_decisions: Delivery-first inversion: the built-not-wired guarantee ran first, not last.
WP5 reviewer machinery stays inside 569 as wave 4.
#558 is a design question settled with the human before wave 3, not dispatched to a commander.
The declared basis lands in hand-written templates, not through generate_spine.py.

current_wave.objective: Guarantee that what this epic delivers is actually wired, and close the one gate in the corpus that cannot pass.
exit_criteria: A committed census with the generate_spine.py disposition settled.
Either a registration lint plus vocabulary rule, or deletions and a recorded honest null.
A list-valued match works and is red-proved against the shipped revision.
Both PRs merged green to main.

issues.title: Built-not-wired: census, then lint or delete (#345 #444 #368)
issues.desired_outcome: Every check-shaped script is reachable from a real check, deleted, or allowlisted with a stated reason, and generate_spine.py's disposition is settled with evidence.
issues.useful_now: Nothing later in the epic is trustworthy until 'built' stops meaning 'not wired'.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A committed census classifying all 26 scripts live/unwired/dead with evidence per row.
issues.implementation_latitude: Lint shape and where it runs.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Do not fix this by adding another unwired checker.

issues.title: Verdict mechanism: list-valued match, refuse a mistyped match shape (#371)
issues.desired_outcome: A match may name a set of acceptable values; a mistyped match shape is refused rather than becoming a silently unsatisfiable gate.
issues.useful_now: It is a check that cannot pass, and the wedge pushes a Commander toward fabricating a verdict.
issues.appetite: Small; two comparison sites plus tests.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A red-proof pinned to the shipped revision that a list-valued match is unsatisfiable before and satisfiable after.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Backward compatibility with every existing scalar match is non-negotiable.

parked_possibilities: The stalled spec-to-template migration: 2 specs against 19 roles, already drifted. Human ruled it out of 569; recorded as episodes/active/569-001.md.
No automated defence against a PR that turns main red: mergeable+approved+no-conflict all say yes, and CI is windows-only and known-red so its verdict is ignored by policy. Measured this wave.
Imperative bloat across the remaining spine steps.
Whether record() on a survey should evaluate null-kind postconditions (#422 D-scope).

completed_outcomes.outcome: Census of all 26 check-shaped scripts (17 live, 8 unwired, 1 dead) committed at docs/CHECK_SCRIPT_CENSUS.md; RegistrationLint and VocabularyRule shipped blocking with negative self-tests; #444 gauge-field reconciliation shipped after finding a live doc/code drift; prove_docstring_only.py deleted as dead.

List-valued artifact match now means membership at both engine comparison sites with scalar behaviour unchanged; a present-but-non-dict match, which previously crashed with an uncaught AttributeError, is now a clean refusal.

wave_evidence.claim: generate_spine.py's because-requirement is a cheap entry point for work package 1
wave_evidence.expected: a live compiler whose discarded field could be carried through
wave_evidence.observed: FALSIFIED as a route. The compiler is live via spine_lifecycle -> MCP spine_open and is genuinely tested, but no shipped role skill routes through it. Every driven spine comes from init_work_area.py resolving a hand-written template, and COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json carries 0 `because` fields against 19 check-null postconditions.

wave_evidence.claim: The built-not-wired population is mostly dead code
wave_evidence.expected: an honest-null outcome of deletions and no lint
wave_evidence.observed: FALSIFIED. 17 live, 8 unwired, 1 dead. Every successive measurement — #345's original six, the Admiral's pre-census of 7 live, the commander's first pass of 12 — understated enforcement, because each measured a narrower surface than enforcement actually uses.

wave_evidence.claim: A commander's self-reported quality signals are sufficient to merge on
wave_evidence.expected: the commander's own account of its work would hold
wave_evidence.observed: FALSIFIED for w1-wiring. An Admiral-ordered clean-room review found its VocabularyRule negative self-test never called the real scan (verified by breaking _prose_files() and watching all 7 tests still pass), and that its reported green suite was actually 1 failed. Both were caught only because an independent reviewer ran, which it had not.

wave_evidence.claim: A MERGEABLE, reviewed, conflict-free PR is safe to merge
wave_evidence.expected: the available automated signals would be sufficient
wave_evidence.observed: FALSIFIED by direct test. Merging #645 into main cleanly produced a tree where the map freshness test failed. Every automated signal said yes; CI is windows-only and known-red so its verdict is ignored by policy. Only a hand-run suite on the merged tree caught it.
wave_evidence.source: Admiral merge-verification in a scratch worktree

wave_evidence.claim: A well-specified launch order lets a sonnet commander do this work
wave_evidence.expected: unknown; this was the epic's own thesis under test
wave_evidence.observed: SUPPORTED for wave 1. Both lanes delivered at sonnet. w1-wiring self-corrected its own census mid-run and documented the correction; w1-verdict found and fixed a crash beyond its brief and its crew reproduced every evidence figure independently. The one quality gap was caused by the Admiral's dispatch mechanism, not the tier.
wave_evidence.source: both RESULT.md artifacts and the crew registries
